options.content:
**Wall of Shame — $network.** Three summary rows reconcile who *should* be validating against what is *actually* observable, then the table drills down per validator.

**Validators** — the roster & on-chain picture. *Total* = every known node (portal roster ∪ reporting ∪ on-chain active). *Internal* = Foundation/Labs nodes (name contains 'GenLayer'). *On-chain active* = live Staking.activeValidators() set (includes quarantined). *Quarantined* = live on-chain Staking.getAllQuarantinedValidators() (NOT the portal). *Portal: active / Inactive / Banned* = portal roster status counts. Note: on-chain active often differs from portal active because the portal syncs periodically.

**Metrics** — *Reporting (metrics)* = nodes emitting Prometheus in the last 5 min. *Metrics SHAME* = on-chain active but silent on metrics.

**Logs** — *Reporting (logs)* = nodes shipping logs to Loki in the last 5 min. *Logs SHAME* = on-chain active but silent on logs.

**Versions** (over the on-chain active set). *Version OK* = active nodes on the latest version seen in the wild ($latest_version). *Version behind* = active + reporting but on an older release. *Version unknown* = active but not reporting, so version can't be read. These three sum to the on-chain active count.

**Table columns** — *In Portal* Yes/No · *Participating* active / quarantined / not participating (live, on-chain) · *Metrics/Logs* ON/SHAME/- · *Node Version* + *Version* (OK/behind vs latest, no manual target). Rows sorted worst-first.

targets.root_selector:
.result | ltrimstr("0x") | .[128:]
| [ range(0; (length/64)) as $i | .[$i*64:($i+1)*64] ]
| map(select(length==64) | {node: ("0x" + (.[24:64] | ascii_downcase)), onchain_active: 1})
| map(select(.node != "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"))

Live on-chain active set (Staking.activeValidators()) reconciled against the portal roster and Grafana by node address. Lists ALL portal validators for $network (active + inactive + quarantined), plus any node reporting/active but not in the portal. Participating: active = in the live on-chain active set, not active = not. In Portal: Yes/No. Metrics/Logs: ON = reporting last 5m, SHAME = on-chain active but not reporting, - = not applicable (not active and not reporting). Blocks Behind from metrics. Worst-first.
